title: CODATA lists standard gravity as exactly 9.806 65 m/s²
summary: The 2022 listing marks 'standard acceleration of gravity' exact. It is a conventional value in the table, not a measurement of local g.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'standard acceleration of gravity 9.806 65 (exact) m s⁻²'. The exact mark means the table is stating a conventional value, the same way it marks defined constants exact. It is not a claim that every place on Earth has this acceleration. Local gravity is a measurement. This line is the standard value the listing names.
